objective: By the end of the lesson, learners will have practiced and developed the sub-skills of reading for gist, detail and specific information in the context of an article about super recognizers.
materials:
- OFD2 Workbook, pp. 4-5
- YouTube video: "Quiz! Are YOU a Super Recognizer?" (https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=zvnaxDI300o)

stages.stage_aim: To activate learners' interest in the theme of face recognition ability
stages.procedure:
- Orientation questions — In pairs, Ss discuss: Can you remember people's faces well? Have you ever recognised someone you only met once? Do you notice when an actor appears in different movies? 2 min.
- Brief whole-class feedback. 1 min.
- Set up the video: "You may be a super recogniser. Let's watch this video and find out!" 1 min.
- Play the YouTube video "Quiz! Are YOU a Super Recognizer?" Ss watch, take brief notes, and answer: Do you think you are a super recogniser? 3 min.
- Feedback — elicit responses. 1 min.
- Pre-teach vocabulary: *prosopagnosia*, *extraordinary*, *recruit*, *remarkable*, *scanners*. Display each word with phonemic script and brief definition. Drill pronunciation chorally and individually. 3 min.

stages.stage_aim: To get the general idea of the article
stages.procedure:
- Ss read the reading strategy box (Reading for gist or detail) then read the article quickly. 2 min.
- Ss complete Exercise 1 (summary — choose the correct words). 2 min.
- Pair check and whole-class feedback. 1 min.

stages.stage: Reading for detail and specific information
stages.stage_aim: To identify key facts and supporting details in the article
stages.procedure:
- Ss read the article again and complete the true/false task (Exercise 2), correcting false statements. 6 min.
- Pair check. Whole-class feedback on answers. 4 min.
- Ss complete Exercise 3 (answer the questions). 3 min.
- Pair check. Whole-class feedback. 2 min.

stages.stage: Reading for inference and personal response
stages.stage_aim: To draw inferences and form personal opinions based on the text
stages.procedure:
- Ss complete Exercise 4 (personal answers about whether they are super recognizers and the advantages or disadvantages). 2 min.
- Pair check. Elicit a few responses from different pairs. 3 min.

stages.stage_aim: To discuss ideas from the reading and share personal responses
stages.procedure:
- In pairs, Ss discuss: Would you want to be a super recognizer? Why or why not? What would be the hardest part of the job? 3 min.
- Content and language feedback. 2 min.

stages.stage_aim: To reflect on key takeaways and consolidate learning
stages.procedure:
- Elicit from Ss: What is the most surprising thing you learned about super recognizers? What new vocabulary do you remember? 3 min.
- Brief error correction if needed. 2 min.
